name: Lucky Strike
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +5, adaptive luck racial trait, halfling
benefit:
Spend a use of your adaptive luck racial trait to reroll the damage from a single weapon attack. You deal damage equal to the new damage roll, or the original roll, whichever is greater.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 125
You can spend 5 stamina points instead of a use of adaptable luck to reroll the damage from a single attack.
flavor: Your luck increases the potency of your weapon attacks.
